question: _________ gas emitted from chlorofluorocarbons is harmful to the ozone layer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chlorine**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** gas emitted from chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) that is harmful to the ozone layer is chlorine**
 
• **CFCs are nontoxic, nonflammable chemicals that contain chlorine, carbon, and fluorine atoms.**
 
• When **CFCs rise into the stratosphere, **they are broken down by ultraviolet radiation, releasing chlorine atoms.
 
• These **chlorine atoms react with ozone molecules and destroy them.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• About Ozone layer:

 
 
• CFC has disrupted this balance and increase the degradation of Ozone gas which is called Ozone depletion.
 
• Although ozone depletion is occurring in the stratosphere, the depletion is especially marked over the Antarctic region.
 
• This has resulted in the formation of a large area of the thinned ozone layer, commonly called the ozone hole
 
• Montreal Protocol in 1987 bans the production of CFCs, halons, and other ozone-depleting chemicals.
 
• World Ozone Day is observed on the 16th of September every year.
 
• The O3 layer present in the stratosphere protects us from the harmful UV rays of the sun.
 
• Ozone layer thickness is measured in Dobson units.
